evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Detect and refine source-traceable workflow security boundaries using complete model exploration and preserved negative controls.
intent.acceptance: Additional independently replayed model boundary with correct intended mutation invariant, complete secure exploration, retained source/config/tool identity and preserved prior controls. Missing runtime and unfinished checker results are unavailable evidence.

evaluation.reason: Disjoint post-adoption native delivery subtotals; no exhaustive matched historical baseline.

definition.authoring: V1 source-history-informed retrospective acceptance retained unchanged; synthetic scorer examples do not establish native coverage.

evidence.opportunity: Source-goal-native condition transitions at immutable landed commits after verified workflow adoption.
filters: Actual first parent, exact public repository identity and frozen cutoff.
Independent source/behavior oracle, never producer prose, closure or merge alone.
Lifetime-deduplicated native conditions; partial evidence is a subtotal, not an exhaustive zero.
Editable tracking markers establish candidate lineage, not receipt-verified creation.
evidence.collection: Offline digest-checked original API/source custody and bounded local native replay; no API calls during collection or scoring.

model.architecture: One source-goal-native instrument with separately preserved strict acceptance, partial value, safeguards and attribution.
model.recommendation: Not rated: no agreed native keep bar or measured costs.

metrics.name: independently replayed additional model boundaries
metrics.formula: Sum distinct independently established native condition repairs delivered within the disjoint period; null when defining evidence is unavailable.

limitations: Partial native evidence is not full-goal acceptance.
Full safeguards, exclusive causation, creation-receipt attribution and costs are unmeasured.
No-op claims, failed investigations and absent surviving outcomes do not establish zero native delivery.
Current public issue bodies are acquired originals, not historical body revisions.
